images.title: Mangoes only in season
images.purpose: Show that the mango tree's in season months are the data that answer the question, so the off season zero months are left out of the mean.
images.composition: One short bar graph across the frame with 12 month slots, 5 amber bars in the middle and small grey markers in the other slots, plus one mean line and one median caption.
exact_structure: A dark grey (#2B2B2B) baseline with 12 equal month slots in order from January to December; only the first slot is labelled Jan and the last slot Dec.
Slots 3 to 7 (March to July) hold 5 amber (#E69F00) bars of heights 8, 24, 41, 16 and 5 units drawn to scale, each with its value printed above it.
The other 7 slots (January, February and August to December) each have only a small hollow grey (#6B7280) circle sitting on the baseline, no bar.
A teal (#0072B2) bracket under the 5 amber bars is labelled Mar to Jul.
A green (#009E73) dashed horizontal line runs across the 5 amber bars only, at height 18.8, labelled Mean = 18.8 at its right end.
A small caption at the top right reads Median = 16, in reddish purple (#CC79A7).
rejection: a number of bars other than 5
bars in slots other than the 3rd to the 7th
the mean line drawn at a height other than 18.8 or across the empty months
a number of grey circles other than 7
images.takeaway: Use only the data that fits the question: in season the tree gives a mean of 18.8 and a median of 16 mangoes a month.
images.description: A 12 month bar graph with amber bars of 8, 24, 41, 16 and 5 from March to July, grey circles for the other months, a mean line at 18.8 and a median of 16.
images.context: Shown beside the concept text and video for this concept.
images.teaching_notes: Ask why the seven empty months are not failed harvests, and what the mean would be if they were counted.

image_decisions.why: Seeing the in season bars apart from the empty months makes the choice of data concrete.
